title: The Home page, next version — round 2, fifth look

steps.path: Pages → Home, Now playing on the TV and a speaker
steps.headline: Previous, play/pause and next now sit inside the Now playing block, on TVs and on speakers alike.
steps.changed: Play/pause left the remote and the speaker's separate row: it lives with what is playing. On the TV the buttons go through the remote, so they work in any app.
steps.notice: The big middle button shows pause while playing and play while paused. A soundbar playing the TV's sound has none, as there is nothing of its own to pause.
steps.risk: Previous and next do whatever the app on the TV does with those keys; some apps skip, some seek.

steps.headline: The remote opens from a full-width bar labelled Remote under Now playing; open, it reads Hide remote and its arrow flips.
steps.changed: The round remote icon is gone. The bar says what it does, and the TV's name is no longer cut short beside it.
steps.notice: The power button stays alone on the right of the TV's header.
steps.risk: It adds one row to every paired TV, even with the remote closed.

steps.path: Pages → Home, Destin's Room TV, volume
steps.headline: The TV's volume bar and the remote's volume buttons now change the soundbar, because that is where the TV's sound comes out.
steps.changed: Home Assistant reports the Sonos Beam's source as TV, so the page sends volume there. The TV box's own volume keys never reached it, which is why volume did nothing.
steps.notice: Moving the TV's volume bar moves the soundbar's bar too: they are the same volume.
steps.risk: If the soundbar is switched to music, the TV's volume goes back to the TV box's own keys.
